description: This file defines the Tangent class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for various trigonometric calculations such as tangent (tan), hyperbolic tangent (tanh), arctangent (atan), inverse hyperbolic tangent (atanh), and atan2 function. It handles validation of inputs, supports array inputs for batch processing, and integrates with helper functions for error handling and calculations.

classes.name: Tangent
classes.description: A class providing static methods for tangent and related trigonometric functions, supporting both scalar and array inputs, with input validation and error handling.

methods.name: tan
methods.description: Computes the tangent of an angle in radians, validating input and supporting array inputs for batch calculations.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic tangent of an angle, supporting array inputs and input validation.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of a number, with validation and support for array inputs.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent, supporting validation and array inputs.

methods.name: atan2
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of y/x considering their signs to determine the correct quadrant, with validation, support for array inputs, and special handling when both inputs are zero.
